## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new capability or example
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: no behavior change
- [ ] build / ci: tooling, images, workflows
- [ ] chore: maintenance

## Breaking change

- [ ] Yes, and the migration is documented in the description
- [ ] No

## Checklist

- [ ] make check passes (versions, example layout, manifest YAML)
- [ ] make test / make lint pass when the change touches code (gateway unit tests, ruff, shellcheck; yamllint/actionlint where installed)
- [ ] Docs updated for the change (root README, docs/, example README)
- [ ] No secrets or usable credentials committed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md was not edited by hand (generated by git-cliff)
- [ ] Version pins changed only through versions.env / make set-version
